integrity: Every four-candidate profile with one, two, or three labeled voters is exhausted. Kemeny is replayed independently through pairwise agreement and Kendall distance, maximin through support and opposition formulations, and every divergent three-voter profile is canonicalized under all candidate and voter relabelings.
scientific_limitations: The result is exact only for the first four-candidate electorate sizes through three voters. The universal three-candidate equivalence is prior work; no larger-electorate frequency law is claimed. The 2012 working paper is dated September but its exact release day was not verified, so the recorded date is the earliest day-resolved public indexing record located for it.
title: Sharp four-candidate, three-voter boundary for Kemeny–maximin divergence
